messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The rule gate has already run. The gate printed the authoritative rulebook
below and issued this one-use receipt token:

GATE_TOKEN: wU54oNBpxtxKKm2yuEv6KQ

Your final JSON must include this exact top-level field:
"gate_token": "wU54oNBpxtxKKm2yuEv6KQ"

Here is the full character rulebook. It is authoritative:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Mara unrolls a map of the ruined royal city.
scenes.visual_description: A windswept hill at dawn overlooking shattered spires; a parchment map weighed down with stones; broken banners flutter in the distance.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of obvious traps.
scenes.visual_description: A single-eyed oil lamp burning blue against twilight, its flame curled like a pointing finger toward the city gates.guidance smoke spelling 'BEWARE'.

scenes.caption: Tin fox scouts the cracked castle gates.
scenes.visual_description: A small clockwork fox with blue glass eyes peering through the bars of a colossal iron gate; weeds curl through the hinges.

scenes.caption: Glass diver emerges from a shattered window.
scenes.visual_description: A figure in a clear diving helmet rising headfirst out of a tall broken window as if surfacing from water; coat shimmering with reflected ruins.

scenes.caption: The team meets in the empty plaza.
scenes.visual_description: A cracked fountain plaza scattered with torn royal banners; the four converge while the lamp hovers on a broken pedestal.

scenes.caption: Frightened faces watch from shuttered windows.
scenes.visual_description: Narrow alley lined with boarded houses; pale eyes peek through cracks; Mara raises a hand in reassurance, lamp casting warm circles.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol clanks past in the fog.
scenes.visual_description: Silhouettes of empty suits of armor marching mechanically through green fog; tin fox crouches behind a barrel, gears silent.

scenes.caption: They find the sleeping tax collector slumped at his post.
scenes.visual_description: A round official snoring over a ledger pillow, stamped papers stuck to his sleeves; a 'TOLL' sign hangs crooked above him.

scenes.caption: Mara pries a sealed permit from his hand.
scenes.visual_description: Mara gently tugging a wax-sealed scroll from the snoring official's grip; the lamp glows nervously overhead.

scenes.caption: Rumors of a great winged beast drift across the rooftops.
scenes.visual_description: Distant shadow with vast wings circling above a cursed tower; the team ducks beneath a collapsed arcade, lamp dimming its eye.

scenes.caption: Tin fox finds a hidden cellar mirror.
scenes.visual_description: A dusty cellar with a tall silvered mirror leaning against rubble; the clockwork fox's tail key glints as it nudges the frame.

scenes.caption: Glass diver dives through the mirror into the cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: Ripples spreading across the mirror's surface as the helmeted figure plunges in, coat trailing reflected starlight.

scenes.caption: Inside the tower, a magic door bars the way.
scenes.visual_description: A circular door carved with shifting runes glowing amber; the diver presses a gloved palm to it; lamp's eye reflected in the brass.

scenes.caption: The lamp whispers the door's true name.
scenes.visual_description: Close-up of the lamp flame stretching into a mouth shape; runes on the door rearranging into welcoming letters.

scenes.caption: Mara maps an escape route through the wreckage.
scenes.visual_description: Mara crouched on a balcony, compass spinning, charcoal lines snaking across her parchment toward a distant stone bridge.

scenes.caption: The rescued one is carried out through the mirror.
scenes.visual_description: Glass diver stepping back out of the silvered surface with a small bundled figure cradled in arms; mirror rippling like pond water.

scenes.caption: Armored patrols close in as alarms ring.
scenes.visual_description: Bells clanging atop ruined towers; metal silhouettes converging from three streets; tin fox sprints ahead, sparks at its heels.

scenes.caption: They cross the long bridge at sunrise.
scenes.visual_description: A crumbling stone bridge stretching over a misty chasm; the team silhouetted against pink dawn; behind them the city smolders, ahead open country.
